title: Kingman crash survivor went to the back of the craft

tellings.quote: she do? His in his own words he said she went back in the craft and stayed in the back.

plain: After a craft crashed near Kingman, Arizona, one survivor from it, a "she", is said to have gone back inside the craft and stayed in the back. Charles Hall, who says he spent three years with tall, white aliens at Area 51, tells Michels this as the local Kingman sheriff told it, "in his own words". It would mean there were living occupants at the crash, and that one of them chose to stay with the wreck.
